headline: The A5 12 02 report is built at 0x1e0db0c with opcode 0x02 and a 14-byte payload (frame length byte 0x12 = 14+4). A second 0x02 variant with a 28-byte payload is built at 0x1e0db5e. Both live inside the 13,346-byte manager 0x1e0aff2.

frame_construction.builder_args: r0 = ctx (r14+0x30), r1 = opcode, r2 = payload ptr, r3 = payload length

d2_18B.frame_len: 14 + 4 = 0x12 (18) - matches the live A5 12 02 frame exactly
d2_18B.payload_ptr: sp+1052 (filled by the copy at 0x1e0daf8 from sp+1080, 0x1c bytes)

payload_layout_proven.evidence: 0x1e07464 serialises the payload pointer field by field: [r2+0x0] rev8 (u32 byte swap), then h[r2+0x4], h[r2+0x6], h[r2+0x8], h[r2+0xa] each rev8 then >>16 (s16 byte swap), then 0x1e07444 is applied at +0x0e and at +0x14

fields.semantic: second group, only inside the 28-byte variant

payload_layout_proven.conclusion: The 14-byte D2 payload is exactly {u32 mask, s16 x4, LT, RT} = 4+8+1+1, which reproduces the live field map without assuming it.

gate_1.effect: when the flag is zero the 14-byte report is NOT built at all

gate_2.effect: a repeat counter is set to 100 for this pass

repeat_loop.code: r0 = b[r15+0x3a]; if (r0 == 0) exit; r0 += -1; b[r15+0x3a] = r0; if ((r0 & 0xff) != 0) goto 0x1e0dae6
repeat_loop.effect: the report is RE-BUILT AND RE-SENT up to 100 times, decrementing a counter in config space

gate_3.code: r1 = b[r15 + 0x11] ; if (r1 == 0) skip; if (r0 == 0) skip
gate_3.effect: the 28-byte variant additionally requires b[cfg+0x11] != 0 and the earlier result to be nonzero

send_gate.boolean: emit(A5 12 02, 14B payload) when b[cfg+0x10] != 0, repeated while the counter b[cfg+0x3a] decrements from 100; emit the 28-byte 0x02 variant when b[cfg+0x11] != 0 && b[cfg+0x10]-derived result != 0
send_gate.not_proven: what CALLS this region - i.e. the digital-event trigger that explains why idle produces zero frames and a button press produces them. The containing function 0x1e0aff2 is called from 0x1e0a9b4; that chain was not traced in this window.

d2_handler_flag_write.conclusion: The D2 handler stores the enable byte at cfg+0x10 by default and at cfg+0x11 when the selector value is 0x19. These are exactly the two flags that gate the 14-byte and 28-byte reports, so D2 selects a REPORT VARIANT, not just on/off.
d2_handler_flag_write.note: state+0x10/0x11 here are the gate flags proven above; the brief's 'stores enable at state+0x10' is therefore confirmed AND extended to a second flag at +0x11.

input_state: The 28-byte buffer at sp+1080/sp+1024 is the pre-serialisation input snapshot (copied 0x1c bytes by 0x2f92c8 / 0x2f9276 then serialised in place by 0x1e07464). Its internal layout before serialisation is the input-state struct: mask u32, 4 axes s16, LT/RT, plus a second group at +0x14.

fw_u_026.proven: builder address, exact frame construction, payload field map, and the two-flag send gate with the 100-iteration repeat loop
fw_u_026.open: the trigger side (what schedules this path on digital activity) and therefore the full FW-U-026 boolean
fw_u_026.next: trace callers of 0x1e0a9b4 -> 0x1e0aff2 and find the digital-change trigger
